data.description: Luxury High-Floor 2BR | Stunning Marina Views | Prime Torch Tower
data.long_description:
Experience upscale waterfront living in this spacious 2-bedroom apartment located in the iconic The Torch Tower, one of Dubai Marina’s most recognized residential skyscrapers. Spanning 1,258.40 sq. ft., this well-designed apartment offers a modern layout, bright interiors, and an exceptional lifestyle in the heart of Dubai Marina.

Perfect for both end-users and investors, the property combines comfort, convenience, and strong rental potential in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.
